## Professional Experience

### Business Analyst · Egg Roll King

::: {.timeline-date}
Jan 2023 - Apr 2025

Led revenue and traffic performance analysis in a high-volume restaurant environment. Built KPI dashboards to track peak-hour demand, staffing allocation, and daily revenue movement, which improved staffing efficiency and made cost-control discussions more measurable.

::: {.timeline-item}
### Customer Service Analyst · Target

::: {.timeline-date}
Oct 2024 - Jan 2025
:::

Analyzed customer wait-time and service-flow metrics during the holiday season to identify operational bottlenecks. Produced reporting that helped monitor queue efficiency and support process adjustments while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.
